findings.detail: All 25 frozen payload pins match. The seven per-file deltas and concatenated 44059-byte diff reconstruct byte-for-byte from the retained R4 source. Four of five Python files have no function/class AST change; owned_navigation changes only require_actual_install_binding to reject old UID 10169 and use R5 diagnostic labels. Forty-three other functions/classes are unchanged.

All 149 nonce literals are distinct and disjoint from the prior R4 flow and actual R5 install03 flow/state nonce. All 48 plans pass the actual R5 adapter validator. Removing nonce fields leaves each plan byte-equivalent as Python data to R4: 44 inspect plans, exactly three clicks and one fixed public-query set_text. Runtime still requires a fresh flow and once claim; local nonce checks alone are not a claim that no external actor used them.

All eleven original install03 files match their external lengths/SHA256. The unchanged production actual_install function was executed locally with only exact remote-to-local read-path mapping, against those original records and the actual R5 contract parser. UID 10170, signed APK 16d3d1252b84accf0b454b8d9c3dd350031cca3a228cc9a772914d74a0c66b68, full installed inode record and d6ea152c1dcd395f02b2e0fe8002d98bcdf5203251463fd40ae6a17315ca9d98 state wire matched. Historical state is explicitly not a current UI baseline.

Worker still holds the original action lock, performs Main guard then live installed identity before launch/navigation, and requires each sequence independent after-state/restoration. Submission still verifies the current public query inside its own inspection; course selection still uses the current exact card scope. Worker and execute bodies, including finally cleanup, are AST-identical to R4. A first read/action failure stops further mutation, with independent after-state and exact newly owned-task retirement retained; no install, force-stop, old-state rewrite or action replay was introduced.

The exact 121581-byte request SHA622f2985ace3de2e347458e0cce9335c04b15fa560edae97ab56da669511f28d embeds 117925 bytes SHA4c5ec8d10ef8d522e2ba8332230309cdb75e04ab63436a94f37f7f2b90aa50ce. All eight packet files equal the frozen sources. The fixed privileged isolated-Python wrapper pins packet/stage source. Original 600s outer, 180s launch/240s navigation/100s cleanup, CPU1/512MiB and owned resource checker paths are unchanged. This is source binding, not actual resource qualification.

notes: Actual install03 success did not create a UiAutomation connection and therefore does not test the cache hypothesis or focused-window behavior. This review does not convert R4 historical failure into success.

The new README omits some detailed inherited viewport limits; their source and validation bodies remain unchanged. Private trees and pixels are outside this review and must remain outside public evidence.
scope: Frozen R4-to-R5 flow delta, original installation admission, request/source binding and retained scope/cleanup; not a complete helper/runtime review
